name: Inmate Admissions
description:
This dataset contains records of inmate admissions, with 5,000 sampled rows and seven columns. Each row represents an individual inmate identified by inmateid, along with the date they were admitted (admitted_dt) and, where applicable, the date they were discharged (discharged_dt). Demographic fields capture race and gender, while inmate_status_code indicates the inmate's current or recorded status. The top_charge column lists the most serious charge associated with the admission.

The data can support analyses of jail or prison population trends, including admission volumes over time, length of stay calculated from admission and discharge dates, and breakdowns by race, gender, or charge type. It may be useful for public safety research, resource planning, demographic disparity studies, and dashboards tracking inmate status and turnover.
